# OnePointer 0.3.0
设置界面经过重新设计，让快速聚焦与持续高亮都更容易找到和使用。
- 只保留“快速聚焦”和“持续高亮”两个清晰入口 - 持续高亮改为醒目的全宽主按钮，可一键开启或关闭 - 所有设置直接展示，不再折叠“高级设置” - 开机启动、检查更新、帧率和重置整合到快速聚焦页 - 全新 App 图标更明确地表达鼠标指针与聚焦功能 - 新增 OneApps.Studio 更多实用 App 入口
---
The settings window has been redesigned to make both quick focus and persistent highlighting easier to find and use.
- Two clear destinations: Quick Focus and Persistent Highlight - A prominent full-width control enables or disables persistent highlighting - All settings stay visible without a collapsed advanced section - Launch at login, updates, frame rate, and reset now live on the Quick Focus page - A refreshed app icon clearly communicates pointer focus - A new link helps users discover more apps from OneApps.Studio

# OnePointer 0.2.0
快速聚焦快捷手势现在可以自由选择，也可以关闭。
- 默认快捷手势改为双击左侧 Option - 可选择左右侧的 Option、Control、Command 或 Shift - 可完全关闭快速聚焦快捷手势 - 修饰键与其他按键组合使用时不会误触聚焦
---
The quick-focus gesture is now configurable and optional.
- The default gesture is now double-tap left Option - Choose either side of Option, Control, Command, or Shift - Disable the quick-focus gesture completely - Modifier-key combinations do not accidentally trigger quick focus

# OnePointer 0.1.1
聚焦动画现在更清晰、更直接。
- 大聚光圈快速收拢到鼠标位置 - 轻微回弹后稳定，并在 0.85 秒内淡出 - 开启“减少动态效果”时，保持固定圆圈并仅淡入淡出
---
The focus animation is now clearer and more direct.
- A large spotlight rapidly contracts toward the pointer - It lightly rebounds, settles, and fades within 0.85 seconds - Reduce Motion keeps the circle fixed and uses opacity only
